name: Weihnachtsmarkt der Kunigunde
description: Neustadt's Christmas market on the historic Marktplatz and in old courtyards
place: Marktplatz, Juliusplatz, Rathausinnenhof, Hof der Vizedomei
dateNote: courtyards open only on Advent weekends
details:
The Christmas market of Neustadt an der Weinstraße spreads over the historic Marktplatz and Juliusplatz, with the town hall courtyard and the Hof der Vizedomei as extra venues on the Advent weekends (food and handmade crafts there). The historic horse carousel turns again, and there are Advent market concerts and bigger evening concerts.

Marktplatz and Juliusplatz daily 11-20 from 23 November to 22 December; the courtyards Friday 15-20, Saturday and Sunday 11-20. It opens the day after Totensonntag.
